messages:
Sophie: Heads-up — ACME started getting 429s from their dedicated quiet-pool after the plan switch at ~14:20 UTC. Tenant acme-prod-42, pool quiet-pool-3. They say it began immediately after we applied the GrowthReserved plan.

Marco: Can you paste the recent quota keys / ratekey lines and a short tail of logs? :eyes:

Sophie: Pasting sanitized logs (trimmed):

```
2024-09-12T14:19:58Z INFO request tenant=acme-prod-42 pool=quiet-pool-3 rate_key=tenant:acme-prod-42:pool:quiet-pool-3:unit=MINUTE
2024-09-12T14:20:01Z WARN quota_reject tenant=acme-prod-42 code=429 req_id=xyz-123
2024-09-12T14:20:03Z WARN quota_reject tenant=acme-prod-42 code=429 req_id=xyz-124
2024-09-12T14:20:10Z INFO admin.apply_template tenant=acme-prod-42 template=growth_reserved_v2 event=plan_change
```

Sophie: And here's the quota blob the billing pipeline applied (from DB):

```
quota:
  tenant_id: acme-prod-42
  template: growth_reserved_v2
  units: 60
  unit_type: MINUTE
  burst_capacity: 120
```

Marco: That's the smoking gun — unit_type is MINUTE. growth_reserved should be an hourly quota (units per HOUR). If the template was interpreted as minutes the effective sustained capacity is 60/min = 3600/hr vs expected 60k/hr (example), so they hit rejects immediately. :facepalm:

billing-bot: plan_change applied for acme-prod-42 -> growth_reserved_v2 at 3629001050 by billing-service

deploy-bot: quota-template-update v2 deployed to billing pipeline at 3629001048

Lina: Oncall — did autoscaler try to add capacity? I see pool remained healthy but we still returned 429s rather than reroute to standard pool. Any route fallback logs?

Marco: Autoscaler didn't trigger extra GPUs because pool capacity was fine; this is purely policy-level per-tenant enforcement upstream of serving. We need a quick override for the tenant and a fix to template mapping.

Raj: Product question — did we intentionally change growth_reserved_v2 semantics to minute-level windows? If so, we messed up the rollout doc. If not, bug in migration code.

Marco: Quick mitigation steps I executed:
1) Applied admin override to tenant via internal API to set unit_type=HOUR and burst_capacity=7200.
Command used:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://admin.internal/tenants/acme-prod-42/overrides" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"quota_units":60,"unit_type":"HOUR","burst_capacity":7200}'
```
2) Disabled auto-apply of growth_reserved_v2 in billing pipeline (temporary flag).

Sophie: Customer CSM updated — ACME reports 429 frequency dropped to normal levels within ~30s after override. They're back online. :thumbsup:

Janet: Noted — CSM will send a postmortem + credits. I'll loop legal if we need SLA crediting.

Marco: Root cause hypothesis: a recent template migration script accidentally mapped legacy field "units_per_hour" into the runtime field "units" and set unit_type based on a wrong default (MINUTE). I'll open a PR to revert and add unit-type validation on apply.

Raj: Please include a product note in the PR so we can audit other tenants that received growth_reserved_v2 in the same window.

Lina: Follow-ups for eng-runtime:
- Add a sanity check that rejects templates with unit_type not in {HOUR, DAY}
- Emit metric quota_template_applied with unit_type for 7d lookback
- Add automated rollback when applied_count > 0 and metric spike in 429s

Marco: Filing incident ticket: INC-3629. Assigning to billing-pipeline and quota-service owners. Will add repro steps and the offending template blob.

Sophie: Logged customer case #CS-8792 and notified ACME CSM. They'll confirm in a few minutes and close the loop.

Raj: Thanks team. After PR and cross-tenant audit we'll schedule a short postmortem and communication to customers who got the bad template.
